title: Tidy tests/rules: HF-026
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: Python's tempfile.gettempdir checks TMPDIR before TEMP. A Windows shell that exports TMPDIR (some MSYS/Git Bash setups) would put the harness scratch in a folder that the fixed guard (GetTempPath or $env:TEMP, as HF-026 specified) does not accept, so it would still be left behind. Adding $env:TMPDIR to the accepted parents is a one-word change if it is ever wanted.

The C-006 fake engine and the new SL-076 Python shape show that RuleCases' own New-TempDir folders go under GetTempPath (TMP) while the harness scratch goes under TEMP. That is harmless now, but a later case that compares the two locations would need to know about it.

drift: Nothing departs from the design without being declared. The old guard accepted any fsa-rules-* folder anywhere below GetTempPath (StartsWith); the new one takes only a folder directly in TMP or TEMP.…
drift: As declared in the build's open list, the fix does not cover TMPDIR (which Python's gettempdir checks first). The same limit applies to the 8.3 and non-ASCII shapes filed as m1 and m2.
drift: No new drift. The narrower guard (a folder only directly in TMP or TEMP, where the old one took any descendant of GetTempPath) follows the design and was declared by the build.

not reached: A real Windows account whose profile path has a space, where Windows itself sets TEMP/TMP. Every spaced, TEMP≠TMP, 8.3 and non-ASCII shape here was simulated by setting TEMP/TMP in a child process on the sshub account, whose TEMP is C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp with TEMP=TMP.

not reached: Whether Windows 11 26200 actually sets TEMP in 8.3 form for a long or spaced account name. O-001's premise ('commonly') was reproduced only with a FileSystemObject ShortPath, not with a real account profile.
not reached: A real MSYS/Git Bash shell exporting TMPDIR. Only simulated by setting the env var; the build declared the gap as left open.

not reached: What left the 26 pre-existing fsa-rules-* folders in this machine's real %TEMP% (11:41-20:54 IST today, before this slice). The conditions here rule out HF-026, and the fsa-rules-case-* pairs suggest interrupted RuleCases runs, but this was not established.
not reached: RuleCases' Invoke-HarnessRaw under Windows PowerShell 5.1. RuleCases was run only under pwsh 7.
